lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular maxima arranged in distinct horizontal rows along the mid-lateral flank, with spatial density decreasing and inter-blob distance increasing toward the caudal peduncle.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that align with columns of high-luminance blobs, creating a grid-like nodal structure across the central lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary linear features extending horizontally across the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high-intensity pixels on the dorsal edge and shadow-induced low-intensity pixels on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A distribution of approximately 13 high-luminance blobs within the first dorsal fin macro-mask, with higher spatial frequency observed along the base and trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A visible irregular notch on the posterior margin (trailing edge) of the first dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Several elongated dark pixel clusters (commensal organisms) are visible attached to the ventral region near the pelvic fin and one additional cluster positioned above the dorsal ridge.
